payload.title: Measure useful completed checks and attributable referrals
payload.goal: Establish privacy-conscious product and acquisition measurements with explicit coverage.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: Qualify existing owner-controlled Search Console/analytics route; preserve zero-cost and separate venture identity from CommerceLint and excluded assets.
Define completed-check, uncertain-result, next-measurement, report-export, permitted affiliate-click and returning-use metrics with denominators, consent/coverage and internal-test exclusions.
Collect only aggregate category/result/source IDs; exact measurements, photos, customer identifiers and private source queries never enter public analytics.
Freeze baseline/window and readback provenance; missing permissions or unavailable data remain null, not copied zero from dated STATE/METRICS.
Prepare a search-intent/measurement-tool acquisition candidate and verify indexability/canonical/sitemap using existing deployment routes, not purchased traffic.
tests: Denied consent produces no optional measurement calls; allowed payload schema rejects measurements, photos and identifiers.
Duplicate event/internal synthetic check never increases qualified external-use denominator.
Imported collector timestamp/coverage distinguish zero observed events from no data access.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: Scorecard distinguishes helpful completed checks, uncertain guidance, permitted referrals and money.
One declared usefulness/acquisition intervention can be measured honestly despite partial analytics coverage.
payload.rollback: Disable optional tracking, preserve public utility and prior aggregate baseline with coverage limits.
payload.next_eligible_action: Implement allowlisted event schema and denominator fixtures before connecting analytics.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Analytics verification may need owner action; offline metric contract and fixture collector proceed.
